postCutoffEvents.source: 国家发展改革委/财政部/国家能源局
postCutoffEvents.event: Three ministries clarified implementation of the 2018 PV policy, preserving prior tariff treatment for specified pre-531/pre-630 projects.
postCutoffEvents.diagnosticMeaning: This was new policy information after the frozen cutoff and inside the 20d outcome window.

postCutoffEvents.source: 国家能源局 solar-plan midterm evaluation meeting, reported contemporaneously by 中国证券报
postCutoffEvents.event: A solar 13th Five-Year Plan midterm evaluation meeting signaled continued subsidy support, possible upward revision of the PV construction target, household-PV separate management and faster 2019 policy formation.
postCutoffEvents.diagnosticMeaning: Contemporaneous reporting explicitly linked this post-cutoff meeting to the November 5 PV-sector limit-up rally.

preCutoffContext.structuralSurvivorSignal: Pre-cutoff policy commentary already argued the 531 reset could favor low-cost, high-efficiency firms and accelerate grid parity.
preCutoffContext.limitation: The frozen deep company evidence still showed Longi ex-item profit nearly flat and Tongwei only moderate profit growth/weaker operating cash flow, so no clean positive company earnings bridge was available by September 30.

diagnosis.explanation: The very strong 60d/120d PV outcome materially incorporates policy information that did not exist at the September 30 cutoff. The 20d window also contains the October 9 clarification and ends on the November 2 meeting date. These returns therefore cannot be used to claim the frozen No-selection decision was predictably wrong from cutoff-valid evidence alone.

versionImplication.rule: Do not tune discovery/promotion on outcome windows dominated by identifiable post-cutoff regime-changing information.
